assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished original logo for 'Podcut Flow', a friendly professional local podcast editing toolkit. A clean distinctive emblem combines a rounded microphone capsule with a single purposeful diagonal edit/cut gap and two short parallel timeline bars at the base, suggesting synchronized audio and video. Pair the emblem with a precisely spelled, beautifully kerned bold modern geometric sans-serif wordmark 'Podcut Flow'. Horizontal lockup, emblem left and wordmark right, ample clear space, wide 3:1 composition, high-resolution crisp flat vector-like edges. Use a restrained teal emblem and very dark navy wordmark; tasteful simple geometry, excellent legibility at GitHub README size. Transparent background, no shadows, no gradients, no mockup, no extra text, no slogan, no border, no other brand symbols. Output a finished usable logo image, not a presentation sheet or multiple concepts.

Create a NEW opaque dark-theme GitHub README brand banner using this image solely as the reference for the Podcut Flow brand's emblem, typography and horizontal arrangement. This is a new banner asset; leave the reference logo asset unchanged. Match its teal cut-microphone emblem on the left and the exact words 'Podcut Flow' on the right. Use a solid dark charcoal background #0D1117 across the entire canvas, solid clean near-white letters, and teal #00A6A6 emblem. Wide 3:1 composition, generous margins, carefully spaced geometric heavy sans-serif wordmark, same relative proportions as the reference. Every shape must have CLEAN SMOOTH SOLID EDGES and uniform flat fill. Absolutely NO rough edges, scratches, grain, distressed texture, sketch marks, stippling, speckles, halos, outlines, gradients or shadows. No transparent pixels: make an opaque dark brand header designed to look excellent at a width of 560 pixels in a README. Only the emblem and 'Podcut Flow', no other text.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a finished, beautifully designed visual quick-start guide for Podcut Flow, the local podcast editor workflow for Codex and Claude Code. This is a clear explanatory illustration, not an actual software screenshot. Portrait 2:3 poster, high-resolution, bright warm-white background, dark navy typography, teal accents, small coral highlights. Crisp flat editorial illustration, rounded cards, generous whitespace, premium approachable software documentation aesthetic. Six evenly balanced cards arranged as two columns by three rows, numbered 01 through 06 in unambiguous reading order left-to-right then downward. Use short connecting arrows only where they clarify reading order. At the top a tasteful microphone-with-diagonal-cut symbol and the title exactly 'Podcut Flow'; subtitle exactly 'FROM RECORDING TO EPISODE'. All text must be large and perfectly legible. Each card has a practical illustration and these exact words: Card 01 title 'ADD YOUR FILES', caption 'One episode folder', illustration folder containing three video thumbnails and two audio waveforms. Card 02 title 'OPEN YOUR AI EDITOR', caption 'Codex / Claude Code', second small line 'Share the repo + folder', illustration a laptop with a simple chat bubble and folder link, no fake product interface or external brand logo. Card 03 title 'SET UP + MAP SOURCES', caption 'Guest / Host / Wide', second line 'Install missing tools', illustration three clearly distinct cameras above two separate microphones and a small gear. Card 04 title 'SYNC + CHOOSE A LOOK', caption 'Natural / Warm / Contrast', illustration aligned audio waveforms and three tasteful color versions of the same simple abstract podcast scene, with one option visibly selected. Card 05 title 'EDIT + TRANSCRIBE', caption 'Separate guest + host audio', illustration a tidy edited video timeline above two independent waveform lanes and a document with timestamp lines. Card 06 title 'CHOOSE YOUR DELIVERY', illustration a clean two-way fork, with left choice exactly 'PREMIERE PROJECT' and beneath 'Review + render yourself', right choice exactly 'RENDERED VIDEO' and beneath 'Ready to watch'. Below the six cards a compact footer exactly 'TRANSCRIPTS INCLUDED: TXT / SRT / VTT / JSON'. Keep both final delivery branches equally visible. Keep text exactly as specified, do not add arbitrary claims, extra stages or small unreadable paragraphs. No stock-photo people, no photorealistic computer screen, no watermark, no decorative clutter. Ensure the entire poster including footer fits without cropping.
